entry.title: TAG Heuer | The New TAG Heuer Formula 1 Solargraph x Oracle Red Bull Racing

media:group.media:title: TAG Heuer | The New TAG Heuer Formula 1 Solargraph x Oracle Red Bull Racing
media:group.media:description:
Ten years in the making.
The new TAG Heuer Formula 1 Solargraph x Oracle Red Bull Racing celebrates ten years of partnership, where precision, performance, and an uncompromising drive to win have defined every lap.
From first victories to championship titles, this special edition channels our shared pursuit of success, brought to life through @redbullracing's signature blue-and-red color palette with a sandblasted 38mm steel case, a bidirectional TH-Polylight bezel, and a Solargraph movement powered by both natural and artificial light.
The journey races on, with every thrilling second still to come.
#TAGHeuer #TAGHeuerFormula1

entry.title: TAG Heuer | Ready For Every Run With The New TAG Heuer Connected Calibre E5 Running Edition

media:group.media:title: TAG Heuer | Ready For Every Run With The New TAG Heuer Connected Calibre E5 Running Edition
media:group.media:description:
Progress has no finish line.​
Introducing the new TAG Heuer Connected Calibre E5 Running Edition 45mm, where discipline meets data. Encased in sandblasted grade 2 titanium, its sophisticated watchfaces bring pace, distance, laps, stride, and recovery into focus, giving you the insights to understand your performance and push toward the next milestone. ​
A red ring between the case and bezel and black DLC-coated pushers with red accents bring a distinctive edge, while two interchangeable straps — a four-colored stretch strap and a perforated rubber strap — let you switch up your run.​
#TAGHeuer #TAGHeuerConnected​
